Trace, implement and test: leetcode77 combinations dfs backtracking

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
    vector<vector<int>> res;
public:
    vector<vector<int>> combine(int n, int k) {
        vector<int> curGroup;
        dfs(n, k, 1, curGroup);
        return res;
    }
    void dfs(int n, int k, int startNum, vector<int>& curGroup)
    {
        if (curGroup.size() == k) 
        {
            res.push_back(curGroup);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = startNum; i <= n; i++)
        {
            // 取到第1个, 放进 curGroup
            curGroup.push_back(i);
            // dfs取下一个
            dfs(n, k, i+1, curGroup);
            // clean up               
            curGroup.pop_back();         
        }
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int n = 7, k = 5;
    auto res = sol.combine(n, k); /* 加断点到下一行进行debug, 可以看到结果 */    
    return 0;
}
